name: nzbget
title: NZBGet
description: Usenet download client that is light on memory and CPU: it downloads, verifies, repairs and unpacks NZB files, and Sonarr, Radarr and the other *arr apps can hand it their downloads. After deploying, add your Usenet provider under Settings > News-Servers.

variables.name: NZBGET_PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.description: Password to sign in with; the same pair goes into Sonarr and Radarr when you add NZBGet as their download client

variables.name: NZBGET_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Downloads folder
variables.description: The folder on this server finished and unfinished downloads are kept in, mounted at /downloads (use the folder Sonarr and Radarr see)

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
